meta.description: NEXT is an educational and technology initiative for young people who want to explore ideas and turn them into real projects.

hero.headline: Build what comes next.
hero.subtitle: Two days to explore ideas and turn them into projects.

intro.title: An experience for people who want to create
intro.p1: NEXT is an educational and technology initiative for young people who want to understand how the world is changing and how they can be part of that transformation.
intro.p2: It is not only about learning artificial intelligence. It is about discovering opportunities, developing skills, working in teams and building something real.
intro.quote: It does not matter what you study. What matters is what you build while you do it.
intro.p3: NEXT does not promote a specific higher education institution or guide students toward one specific career path.
intro.p4: Its purpose is to encourage a culture of continuous learning, curiosity, innovation and personal development.
intro.p5: Technology is transforming every field: engineering, medicine, design, business, education, communication, art and entrepreneurship.
intro.p6: The future does not belong to one career. It belongs to those who keep learning.

days.title: A two-day experience
days.day1Body: An inspirational session to understand the present and future of technology.
days.day1Goal: The goal is for each student to imagine a broader future and understand that there are more opportunities than they often realize.
days.day2Body: A practical workshop to turn ideas into projects. Participants will work in teams through a dynamic inspired by a technology startup.
days.day2Goal: Each team will propose an idea, organize, research, design and build an MVP: a first functional version of their project.

lists.day1: Artificial intelligence and new opportunities.|Emerging professions.|How learning and work are changing.|Misinformation about the technology industry.|Real projects and possible paths for young people.|Questions, conversation and guidance.
lists.day2: Brainstorming.|Team formation.|Role assignment.|Fast research.|Use of artificial intelligence tools.|Prototype or MVP development.|Final project presentation.
lists.includes: Two-day experience.|Inspirational talk.|Practical collaborative workshop.|Introduction to artificial intelligence tools.|Team project development.|Final presentation.|Digital material.|Certificate of participation.

flow.title: From idea to MVP
flow.body: NEXT is designed so students do not just hear about innovation, but experience the process of creating something from zero.

includes.title: What is included?
includes.audienceBody: For upper secondary students who are curious about technology, artificial intelligence, innovation, entrepreneurship or project creation.
includes.noExperience: No previous experience is needed. Just the desire to learn, create and build.

initiator.title: About the initiator
initiator.name: José Manuel Cortés Cerón
initiator.body: NEXT was born from the vision of bringing more young people closer to the real opportunities that exist in technology, innovation and education, starting in our region and expanding into new spaces.
